source_citation: Kalman, A., Katz, T., Vincze, M., Longenecker, J., Mathalon, A., Hill, P., and Goodman-Tchernov, B. (2025). Anatomy of a Flash Flood in a Hyperarid Environment: From Atmospheric Masses to Sediment Dispersal in the Sea. Natural Hazards and Earth System Sciences, 25, 3201-3219.
_read_this_first: Every field below is tagged 'reported' or 'derived' in provenance. Never treat a 'derived' value as a paper-reported number. See docs/event_dates.md and docs/mooring_coordinate_derivation.md for the full derivation of anything marked derived.

position.note: Paper states only '~250 m offshore the Kinnet Canal outlet, 13 m depth', no decimal coordinate. Do not use to more precision than the 1.5 km radius implies. Do not substitute AQ-O01 (Wadi Yutum, Jordan) for this point -- see derivation doc §0.

provenance.turbidity_onset: reported (timezone-converted from 09:50 local, IDT UTC+3, via ZoneInfo)
provenance.turbidity_cleared: reported (timezone-converted from 17:15 local Oct 29, IDT UTC+3, via ZoneInfo)
provenance.elevated_duration_hours: derived (differenced from the two timestamps above; matches paper's own '~31 h' prose statement)

transport_regime.evidence: Kalman et al. 2025 Fig. 8c: bottom-water density calculations cross into hyperpycnal (denser-than-seawater) territory for part of the event. Fig. 6B shows TSS-river discharge and sea-bottom TSS (0.15 m above bed) and mid-column TSS (8 m) with distinct, non-coincident peak timing, consistent with the plume alternating which layer carries the sediment mass.
transport_regime.note: Katz et al. (2015) found these floods predominantly form hyperpycnal flows -- the mooring at 13 m near the seafloor is measuring the dominant pathway, not a surface film. The particle engine's hypopycnal/hyperpycnal toggle should be evaluated against this target, and the calibration winner's regime should be stated as a verdict.

instrument_geometry.note: Depths are 'below buoy' per Kalman et al. 2025 Fig. 1c schematic -- top OBS at 8 m below the buoy, bottom OBS+CTD at 0.15 m above the seafloor. Water column depth at the mooring is ~13 m.

calibration_use.why_never: No real observed plume mask exists for AQ-2016-10-28 (the Sentinel-2 extraction is a documented artifact, not ground truth -- see docs/pitch_limitations.md and docs/event_audit.md). Spatial metrics against this target would be meaningless.
